guidance.promptSnippet: Escalate to the GPT-5.6 Sol reviewer when an approach isn't converging or a decision is expensive to reverse
promptGuidelines: Call `advisor` when choosing between approaches that are expensive to reverse — schema, API shape, file layout, a new dependency.
Call `advisor` when the same failure recurs twice, or results contradict what you read in the code.
Call `advisor` BEFORE any destructive or irreversible action: force-push, rm -rf, migrations, rewriting files you didn't author.
Do NOT call `advisor` for orientation, routine edits, or questions you can settle by reading the code or running a command yourself.
After each `advisor` result, restate its key guidance in your next visible reply — collapsed tool cards hide it from the user.
If you already have primary-source evidence contradicting the advisor, surface the conflict in one more `advisor` call rather than silently switching.
